blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 15 contains 29 verses. It opens with: And `David' made him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent. It concludes with: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
